answer: The echo schedule is applied in shale and spiral shows each instalment. A payout is split thus 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 8 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. Anyone therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3849 identities would post 2903 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
